newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested.

Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers; following weekly movement of 133,500 head. The last established price was 64.00 on Thursday. Today's packer bids are 64.00 with asking prices 66.00-68.00. Note all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed: None Last Week: 20,300 Year Ago: 10,400
